data.title: US military has finished striking Iran, CENTCOM says, after explosions heard | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: A US official told The Jerusalem Post that “Everything depends on Iran’s response. If they continue firing, what happened last night could become a daily or even weekly occurrence. We are prepared.”
